benchmark_title: ComposerMind AudioIntegrity Suite 34-Entry Synthetic Ground-Truth Evaluation Corpus

splitsafe.target_condition: Planted cross-partition evaluation leaks (gain-shifted, trimmed, resampled)
splitsafe.detection_criterion: Aligned coherent votes >= 42 in temporal displacement histogram

wavewash.target_condition: Hard digital clipping (run lengths L <= 16 samples vs L > 16 quarantine)
wavewash.detection_criterion: Contiguous rail runs reconstructed via PCHIP cubic Hermite splines

bandcheck.target_condition: Artificial brickwall low-pass cutoff / fake lossless upsampling
bandcheck.detection_criterion: Log power spectral cliff drop >= 25 dB below 0.60 Nyquist
bandcheck.failure_analysis: Natural steep acoustic roll-off on warm solo double bass mimics low-pass cliff (4 false positives); 1 complex roll-off boundary missed (1 false negative)

tempocheck.detection_criterion: Autocorrelation tempogram ratio r = BPM_meas / BPM_label
tempocheck.failure_analysis: Metric octave doubling/halving ambiguities in polyrhythmic passages

tonicfind.target_condition: Mislabeled musical key / non-standard concert pitch detuning
tonicfind.detection_criterion: Detuning-compensated 12-bin chroma correlation against Krumhansl-Kessler templates

phasecheck.target_condition: Inter-channel stereo phase inversion / out-of-phase widening
phasecheck.detection_criterion: Sliding Pearson correlation rho_LR < -0.85 (hard flip) or mono downmix loss Delta E_mono < -3.0 dB
phasecheck.failure_analysis: 100% recall (4/4) on hard 180-degree inverted polarity; 0% recall (0/4) on subtle stereo widening (rho in [-0.2, 0]) where mono downmix loss does not exceed 3.0 dB

driftcheck.target_condition: Transcript clock drift / video pull-down frame mismatch (163 ms/min)
driftcheck.detection_criterion: Windowed speech-energy cross-correlation slope with permutation test p < 0.01
